text:
Lina P: Heads up — partnership ask from CloudCo: they want a tiny terraform example + reference arch for a marketplace listing that shows hybrid (VPC + on-prem connector) networking and a mounted model store. keeping it simple for customers.
Sam K: Got it. Do they need modules for both cloud infra and the connector or one repo that composes both?
Lina P: Prefer one composed example repo, with small opinionated modules (network, compute, connector). marketplace docs reference should point to the composed usage.
Marcus R: For compute we should show a lowest-common-denominator config: 1x g4dn-ish instance + autoscaling hint. Also show quantized model artifact on S3 (or equivalent) and a short note about kms.
Tess O: Also add a validate script so partner engineers can run a quick smoke test. e.g. `./scripts/validate_deploy.sh` that checks endpoints + kv cache warmed.
Sam K: I'll draft a minimal module interface. Proposal: module inputs = { environment, vpc_cidr, connector_endpoint, storage_bucket, kms_key } outputs = { lb_ip, connector_status } Keep resources minimal.
Lina P: sgtm. include examples of both terraform cloud + local terraform+ansible for on-prem bootstrap. Keep examples < 100 LOC per file.
Marcus R: Example usage snippet I sketched:
```
module "redwood_refarch" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/refarch/terraform/modules/refarch-composed"
  version = "v0.1.0"

  environment      = "demo"
  vpc_cidr         = "10.0.0.0/16"
  connector_endpoint= "https://connector.example.com"
  storage_bucket   = "redwood-models-demo"
  kms_key          = "projects/123/locations/global/keyRings/x/cryptoKeys/y"
}
```
Keep provider-agnostic notes above the snippet.
Tess O: For marketplace listing they want a checklist: minimal permissions, CI pipeline hints, security notes (no hardcoded creds), and an integration test that uses a sample prompt. I can write the checklist.
Sam K: We'll lint the module with `terraform fmt` + `tflint` and add a GH action that runs `terraform init && terraform validate` on PRs. Add a small smoke test runner in go/python to hit the endpoint and assert latency < 500ms for tokenized echo.
Lina P: Nice. Also flag doc for customers about quantization profiles and recommended instance types per model size — short table. Keep all licensing / redistribution notes in README (we can't ship model weights).
partner-bot: integration-checker: ci/pipeline (composer) completed — 3 checks passed, 1 warning: lintersuggest.
Marcus R: One more ask from CloudCo legal: include minimal dataflow diagram (png) and an explicit list of network egress endpoints that customers must open. I can make the diagram.
Tess O: I'll author the marketplace doc + checklist and drop a draft link here tomorrow.
Lina P: Great — plan for next steps: Sam PRs module interface sketch, Marcus adds diagram + sample compute sizing, Tess drafts marketplace checklist + smoke test. We'll sync next Wednesday. @Sam K @Marcus R @Tess O :thumbsup:
Sam K: On it.
Marcus R: Sounds good.
Tess O: Thanks!
